label: About
title: About The Heart Behind the Bevel
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 0 recent saved-signal files and 2 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @benoit_tokyo_: yesterday at @emikusano’s opening ✨ 📍@rk_contemporary. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Heart Behind the Bevel: Oblique landscape: a silver octagonal heart-window shell lies on pale stone, far from a small detached hinge-rim fragment. Navy glass holds a partial face, turquoise hair arc and pale hands around a fissured pink-lavender heart with silver branches. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Angular outer silhouette of the dominant silver shell, Stepped silver rims surrounding the heart aperture, and Blue-lit heart aperture containing hands and a pink heart.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
